### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

f### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

.### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

5### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules

factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

D### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

—### Paid off, or repurchased

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"

```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

>### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

n### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"

```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

n### Paid off, or repurchased

factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

_### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"

```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

u### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"

```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

y### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

n### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

:### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

—### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

n### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

s### Paid off, or repurchased

factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

s### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

=### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

g### Paid off, or repurchased

and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules

factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

l### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

h### Paid off, or repurchased

instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal

### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

}### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

)### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`

factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

y### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

>### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

>### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

k### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

r### Paid off, or repurchased

factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

=### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

5### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

m### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`

fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

—### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

n### Paid off, or repurchased

The `credit.loan` machine carries `on enter repurchased { set balance = 0 }`
and the same on `prepaid`. `balance` is the field ROLE the loan's rules
fill — the level-pay balance and its lagged twin, the interest-only survival
factor — so a model ends a loan's cash with one status write and names no
instance's field. A clean-up call repurchases the remaining collateral:

```cfdl
event clean_up_call when time.t == 6 {
  set entity asset.loan.status = "repurchased"
}
```

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.

From that period every stream the loan lowers reads zero, and the journal
records the machine's writes as children of the event's.
